criteria.requirement: Implement cssselect.extensions.PluginTranslator and HTMLPluginTranslator using an instance-local registry without replacing existing subclass mechanisms. register_pseudo(name, callback, *, functional=False,min_args=0,max_args=None,version="1") validates literal names, arity, callable/version, refuses duplicates or builtin static/function names, and returns self. Static callbacks receive actual XPathExpr; functions additionally receive the real Function/Token node. Validate invocation form, arity and XPathExpr return type. Preserve normal XML/HTML/XHTML behavior and native callbacks/errors; expose deterministic extension_fingerprint capability/version declarations and ensure registry isolation.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
